prompt: The first-person perspective begins with a slow, steady movement along a snow-covered trail in the Mardi Himal Trail, Kaski, Nepal, under a night sky. The camera pans slightly to the left, revealing dense, dark trees lining the path, their branches heavy with snow. As the viewer progresses, the camera angle shifts subtly, capturing the crunching sound of snow underfoot and the faint glow of ambient light reflecting off the white landscape. The trail narrows, bordered by a metal railing on the right, guiding the path through the snowy terrain. The camera continues forward, the visibility gradually decreasing due to the thick fog that envelops the area, creating an eerie, muted atmosphere. The surrounding environment is shrouded in darkness, with only the faint outlines of distant mountains barely discernible through the mist. The camera then tilts upward, showing the vast expanse of the foggy sky, before returning to the trail, where the railing becomes more prominent, leading the way through the desolate, wintry scene. The entire sequence maintains a consistent pace, emphasizing the isolation and quietness of the night-time trek through this remote, snow-laden wilderness.
